entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: Second largest city on Otaria, built in a deep wet canyon; steeped in intrigue and death and ruled weakly by the Parliament of Knives.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: City on the open salt flats, contrasted with Aphetto.

entities.name: Raven Guild
entities.description: Organized crime syndicate of wizard grifters, merchants, pickpockets and spies stealing business from the Cabal.

entities.name: Parliament of Knives
entities.description: Body that ran Aphetto, weakly according to the Cabal Patriarch.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: Leader of the Cabal who made Aphetto his seat of power and ordered the Grand Coliseum built.

entities.name: Grand Coliseum
entities.description: Arena built in the swamps by order of the Cabal Patriarch.

entities.name: The Boy
entities.description: Child who ruled Aphetto after the First's death, channeling Cabal leaders; killed by Karona.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Returned after her Rebirth and brought war on Aphetto, annihilating most of its population.

entities.name: The First
entities.description: Cabal leader whose death preceded the Boy's rule.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: Cabal leader channeled by the Boy.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: Cabal leader channeled by the Boy.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: Cabal leader channeled by the Boy.

entities.name: Karona's War
entities.description: War Karona brought to Aphetto with her Eroshian army.

entities.name: Eroshian army
entities.description: Army Karona brought to the canyon.
